title: Issue 03 — single-home purge of multi-host upgrades with exactly one requiredRegions
policy: For every upgrade name that appears on 2+ region hosts and whose requiredRegions consensus is exactly one region (home): removeUpgrade from every non-home host; ensureUpgradeOnHome on home with set.regionId=home and set.requiredRegions=[home]. Skip intentional multi-region chains by name. Skip per-host-local rows (each copy requiredRegions=[self]). Skip empty-req and multi-req multi-hosts (other issues).

scanRule.multiHost: name appears on 2+ of 11 region upgrade lists
scanRule.singleRequired: all non-empty requiredRegions copies are length 1 and agree on the same home
scanRule.actions: removeUpgrade on every non-home host; ensureUpgradeOnHome(home) with set.regionId=home and set.requiredRegions=[home]
exclusions: intentional multi name patterns (even if single-req)
per-host-local rows where each copy requiredRegions equals its host (e.g. Herb patches (1))
empty-req multi-host (handled by other issues / global removes)
multi-req multi-host (intentional chains or other issues)
